annotation.summary_en: A factory director and his accountant must share a single double room in Moscow due to a booking error, leading to a shift in their professional relationship.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: Set in a hotel in Moscow during the busy pre-New Year season, the sketch begins with a hotel receptionist in a shirt and tie leading two guests up a white staircase. The guests are a mustachioed man in a heavy black overcoat and a young blonde woman. The receptionist explains in Russian that they were unable to hold the two separate single rooms previously booked and offers a single double room instead. The man expresses concern, clarifying to the receptionist, Gavrila, that they are not a married couple but a factory director and a chief accountant. Despite his initial hesitation about the appropriateness of the arrangement, the director tips the receptionist with a dollar, and they accept the room. The receptionist exits after jokingly using the Armenian phrase 'aravazelov ari steg'. Inside the room, which features a double bed and wall-mounted TV, the tension eases. After the woman changes into a nightdress and gets into bed, the man emerges from the bathroom in a white singlet. He asks if they should sleep as colleagues or as a married couple. When she chooses the latter, the scene ends with them giggling and playfully wrestling with pillows.
catchphrases: հիմա ոնց որ դիրեկտոր ու հաշվապահ ենք քնելո՞ւ թե՞ ոնց որ մարդ ու կնիկ
